cause: Release-auto tests construct many commits in temporary Git repositories; under CI load a fixture HEAD can become unreadable beyond the current bounded retry, independently of the model-routing implementation under test.
prevention: TASK-AR-651 must harden or remove every release-critical temp-git boundary with observable recovery and a deterministic regression fixture; until then reruns must retain both attempts and classify this known signature rather than erase it.
summary: TASK-AR-646 exact PR CI passed, but main workflow 30406516812 attempt 1 failed after six retryable temporary-repository commits ended with fatal: could not parse HEAD; an unchanged rerun passed Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12.
title: Temp-git fixture HEAD corruption survives bounded retries
